tasks.short: Select shaping wheels and prepare polishing compounds

steps.what: Select shaping wheels and mix and apply abrasives, bort or polishing compounds

tasks.design: Retain wheel selection and physical mixing and application with the gem worker. Digital records do not select and prepare the actual tool and compound.
tasks.previous_blocker: The choice depends on the stone, desired operation and condition of the physical materials.
tasks.enabler_now: No relevant replacement for this craft preparation is established by the supplied digest.
tasks.still_hard: Choose an appropriate abrasive and application for the actual stone.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unsuitable wheel or compound before it damages the work.
tasks.altitude: Improve consistency of craft preparation and tool condition checks.

reach.learn: Recognise when preparation choices can damage the stone

evidence.claim: Physical wheel selection, compound mixing and application are not replaced by production record software; no task saving is established.

assumptions: The worker assesses stone and tool condition and chooses materials during s1; no ready made wheel suitability or compound quality flag is assumed.
No inventory or instruction writing baseline is added to this physical preparation task.
Existing machinery stays in the baseline. No new deployment or additional upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Stones, wheel types and compounds in use
research_questions: Which preparation choices most often cause avoidable rework?

already_counted.description: Tool assessment, material selection, mixing and application

incremental.description: No added operating system or service

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: the complete craft preparation task remains human, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sort rough diamonds by physical characteristics and quality

steps.what: Inspect and sort rough diamonds into categories based on shape, size, color and quality

tasks.design: Keep direct inspection, category judgement and physical sorting with the gem worker. A generic image classifier is not assumed to establish diamond quality.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reliable categories depend on physical features and expert interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: No applicable rough diamond sorting capability is established in the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Assess quality and handle borderline stones consistently.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise features that require closer inspection rather than a forced category.
tasks.altitude: Improve sorting consistency and uncertainty handling.

reach.task: Discuss category evidence for a stone
reach.learn: Distinguish rough sorting from a final appraisal

evidence.claim: The supplied digest does not establish automated rough diamond inspection and sorting; keeping the task human produces no modelled saving.

assumptions: The worker observes shape, size, color and quality and assigns categories during s1; no structured grade or quality flag arrives from an uncounted producer.
Physical separation and handling remain fully counted. Recording or appraisal tasks earn no duplicated saving here.
No new equipment or model is deployed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Sorting criteria and frequency of borderline stones
research_questions: Which category boundaries produce disagreement between experienced sorters?

already_counted.description: Inspection, category judgement and physical sorting

incremental.description: No added deployment or monitoring work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: physical inspection and sorting remain fully counted, giving zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Strengthen craft consistency and the handling of uncertainty rather than promise unsupported software savings.
reach: Help jewelers understand finishing constraints and rough sorting evidence
role.ambitious_version: A gem worker whose physical preparation and sorting decisions are careful, consistent and clearly explained.
